Sales, Delivery & Refunds

The public shop and automated checkout are not yet active. No product is sold merely because it appears in a preview section.

Custom services

For commissioned work, scope, milestones, revision limits, delivery format, licence, price and cancellation terms must be confirmed in a written proposal or contract before payment.

Digital products

Before the shop opens, each product must state its file format, licence, compatibility, delivery method and refund eligibility. Where immediate download begins with consent, statutory cancellation rights may differ by jurisdiction.

Problems with delivery

If a paid item is missing, corrupt or materially different from its description, contact hello@fourthdimension.studio with the order details so the issue can be investigated.

Final refund wording must be aligned with the seller’s registered jurisdiction, payment provider and target markets before checkout is enabled.
